             NULLIF(SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value), 0), 2) AS freight_pct

JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY r.macro_region
ORDER BY freight_pct DESC
LIMIT 100;

WITH seller_rates AS (
  SELECT
    s.seller_id,
    SUM(si.commission_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(si.gross_amount), 0) AS rate
  FROM settlement_items si
  JOIN settlements s ON s.settlement_id = si.settlement_id
  GROUP BY s.seller_id
)
SELECT
  ROUND(
    (SELECT SUM(commission_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(gross_amount), 0)
     FROM settlement_items),
    4
  ) AS platform_commission_rate,
  ROUND(MIN(rate), 4) AS min_seller_commission_rate,
  ROUND(AVG(rate), 4) AS avg_seller_commission_rate,
  ROUND(MAX(rate), 4) AS max_seller_commission_rate
FROM seller_rates
LIMIT 1;

WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp)::int AS yr,
         EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp)::int AS mo,
         SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) AS gmv
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT m18.mo AS month,
       ROUND(m17.gmv, 2) AS gmv_2017,
       ROUND(m18.gmv, 2) AS gmv_2018,
       ROUND(100.0 * (m18.gmv - m17.gmv) / NULLIF(m17.gmv, 0), 2) AS yoy_pct
FROM monthly m18
JOIN monthly m17 ON m17.mo = m18.mo AND m17.yr = 2017
WHERE m18.yr = 2018
ORDER BY m18.mo
LIMIT 12;

       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.review_score <= 2) / COUNT(*), 2) AS low_score_rate

    FROM refunds
    WHERE reason_code IS NOT NULL
) rr ON rr.order_id = r.order_id
GROUP BY rr.reason_code
ORDER BY rr.reason_code
LIMIT 10;
